scanNote:
4-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASh (114-bet). Yuqorida yashil 'Module Self-Assessment 4 (Units 13 - 15)'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Underline the correct word in bold.' 1 Dogs make wonderful COLLEAGUES/COMPANIONS for children and the elderly. 2 Elephant tusks are extremely VALUABLE/VALUELESS. 3 Rex started COLLECTING/WAGGING his tail happily when he saw his owner. 4 To visit a web site you simply EXCHANGE/ENTER the address. 5 A man on a float BANGED/BLEW his whistle and everyone started dancing. 6 You can CONNECT/STORE information inside a computer. 7 Rhinos are facing CAPTIVITY/EXTINCTION because they are killed for their horns. 8 You can TRAIN/LEARN elephants to perform tricks. 9 We all must help to VALUE/SAVE rhinos. 10 Children can use the Internet to CHAT/PHONE with people. 11 It's very difficult to SURVIVE/BREED green-cheeked parrots. 12 There were a lot of people WEARING/WAVING flags during the parade. (12 marks)
2) 'Fill in the correct word/phrase.' Qiya: 'hunt, download, hand, smuggle, surf, extinct, guard, species, in exchange for, elaborate'. 1 The men at the Hamamatsu Kite Festival wore beautiful costumes with ...... designs. 2 It is illegal to ...... endangered animals like tigers for their skins. 3 Nowadays, most children know how to ...... the net. 4 The WWF works hard to prevent endangered animals becoming ...... . 5 One of the reasons dogs make great pets is that they can be trained to ...... your house. 6 If you find any information on the net about dolphins, can you ...... it for me, please? 7 Many ...... of fish and seabirds were harmed by the oil spill. 8 If you like, I can give you a ...... with your homework. 9 The man was caught trying to ...... a box of elephant tusks into the country. 10 We were given food and accommodation ...... helping to clean up the oil-covered beaches. (10 marks)

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Fill in the correct preposition from the list.' Qiya: 'for, in, with, on, from, at, without, about'. 1 The festival is held ...... the beginning of August every year. 2 He put on a hat to protect himself ...... the sun. 3 Scientists are worried ...... the destruction of the rainforest. 4 The memories of the Rio carnival will stay ...... me forever. 5 Computers are ...... doubt a very useful invention. 6 Elephants should live and breed ...... the wild. 7 Josh was amazed ...... the beauty of the place. 8 Bob's message appeared ...... the screen. 9 ...... my opinion, we should all help protect our planet. 10 Are you ready ...... the first question? (10 marks)
• 'Grammar':
4) 'Rewrite the sentences in reported speech.' (Tyulen surati.) 1 "Seals are in danger of extinction," said the WWF representative. 2 "I was delighted to see such a rare animal," said Tom. 3 "You can help us with our campaign," she said. 4 "Can you help me find something on the Internet, please?" Jo asked me. 5 "We went on a trip to the zoo," said the children. 6 "I have never been taught how to use a computer," said Mr Brown. 7 "I've read lots of magazine articles about shopping on the Internet," said Jane. 8 "It is a bad idea to give personal information to 'chat friends'," he said. (16 marks)

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '114'.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word in bold. (12 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin to'g'ri so'z tagiga chizing. (12 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
13-15 UNITLAR LUG'ATI.

JAVOBLAR:
  1 companions  2 valuable
  3 wagging  4 enter  5 blew
  6 store  7 extinction  8 train
  9 save  10 chat  11 breed
  12 waving


⚠ 'A COLLEAGUE':

  = hamkasb (ishda).
  ⚠ 'companion' = hamroh.


⚠ 'VALUELESS':

  = qadrsiz.
  ⚠ 'valuable' = qimmatli.


⚠ 'TO BLOW A WHISTLE':

  = hushtak chalmoq.
  ⚠ 'bang' - nog'ora uchun.

items.textEn: 1 Dogs make wonderful colleagues/companions for children and the elderly.
items.uz: 1 Itlar bolalar va keksalar uchun ajoyib hamroh.

items.textEn: 2 Elephant tusks are extremely valuable/valueless.
items.uz: 2 Fil tishlari juda qimmatli.

items.textEn: 3 Rex started collecting/wagging his tail happily when he saw his owner.
items.uz: 3 Rex egasini ko'rganda dumini xursand likillata boshladi.

items.textEn: 4 To visit a web site you simply exchange/enter the address.
items.uz: 4 Saytga kirish uchun shunchaki manzilni kiritasiz.

items.textEn: 5 A man on a float banged/blew his whistle and everyone started dancing.
items.uz: 5 Aravadagi erkak hushtak chaldi va hamma raqsga tusha boshladi.

items.textEn: 6 You can connect/store information inside a computer.
items.uz: 6 Ma'lumotni kompyuter ichida saqlashingiz mumkin.

items.textEn: 7 Rhinos are facing captivity/extinction because they are killed for their horns.
items.uz: 7 Karkidonlar shoxlari uchun o'ldirilgani sababli yo'qolib ketish xavfiga duch kelmoqda.

items.textEn: 8 You can train/learn elephants to perform tricks.
items.uz: 8 Fillarni fokus ko'rsatishga o'rgatish mumkin.

items.textEn: 9 We all must help to value/save rhinos.
items.uz: 9 Hammamiz karkidonlarni saqlab qolishga yordam berishimiz kerak.

items.textEn: 10 Children can use the Internet to chat/phone with people.
items.uz: 10 Bolalar Internetdan odamlar bilan suhbatlashish uchun foydalanishi mumkin.

items.textEn: 11 It's very difficult to survive/breed green-cheeked parrots.
items.uz: 11 Yashil yuzli to'tiqushlarni ko'paytirish juda qiyin.

items.textEn: 12 There were a lot of people wearing/waving flags during the parade.
items.uz: 12 Parad davomida ko'p odamlar bayroq silkitardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word/phrase. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 elaborate  2 hunt  3 surf
  4 extinct  5 guard  6 download
  7 species  8 hand  9 smuggle
  10 in exchange for


⚠ 'TO PREVENT ... BECOMING':

  = ... bo'lishining oldini olmoq.


⚠ 'TO BE CAUGHT + -ING':

  = ... qilayotganda qo'lga
  tushmoq.


⚠ 'TO HARM':

  = zarar yetkazmoq.


⚠ 'NOWADAYS':

  = hozirgi kunda.

items.sentence: 1 The men at the Hamamatsu Kite Festival wore beautiful costumes with ___ designs.
items.uz: Hamamatsu varrak festivalidagi erkaklar murakkab naqshli chiroyli kostyumlar kiygan edi.

items.sentence: 2 It is illegal to ___ endangered animals like tigers for their skins.
items.uz: Yo'lbars kabi xavf ostidagi hayvonlarni terisi uchun ovlash noqonuniy.

items.sentence: 3 Nowadays, most children know how to ___ the net.
items.uz: Hozirgi kunda ko'p bolalar Internetda kezishni biladi.

items.sentence: 4 The WWF works hard to prevent endangered animals becoming ___.
items.uz: WWF xavf ostidagi hayvonlarning yo'qolib ketishining oldini olish uchun qattiq ishlaydi.

items.sentence: 5 One of the reasons dogs make great pets is that they can be trained to ___ your house.
items.uz: Itlarning ajoyib uy hayvoni bo'lish sabablaridan biri - ularni uyingizni qo'riqlashga o'rgatish mumkin.

items.sentence: 6 If you find any information on the net about dolphins, can you ___ it for me, please?
items.uz: Agar Internetda delfinlar haqida ma'lumot topsang, men uchun yuklab bera olasanmi?

items.sentence: 7 Many ___ of fish and seabirds were harmed by the oil spill.
items.uz: Ko'p baliq va dengiz qushlari turlari neft to'kilishidan zarar ko'rdi.

items.sentence: 8 If you like, I can give you a ___ with your homework.
items.uz: Xohlasang, uy vazifangda yordam bera olaman.

items.sentence: 9 The man was caught trying to ___ a box of elephant tusks into the country.
items.uz: Erkak mamlakatga bir quti fil tishini kontrabanda qilmoqchi bo'lganda qo'lga tushdi.

items.sentence: 10 We were given food and accommodation ___ helping to clean up the oil-covered beaches.
items.uz: Neft bosgan plyajlarni tozalashga yordam berganimiz evaziga bizga ovqat va turar joy berildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 at  2 from  3 about  4 with
  5 without  6 in  7 at  8 on
  9 In  10 for


⚠ PREDLOGLI IBORALAR:

  AT the beginning of = boshida
  protect FROM = ...dan himoya
  worried ABOUT = ... haqida
    tashvishda
  stay WITH me = men bilan qolmoq
  WITHOUT doubt = shubhasiz
  IN the wild = yovvoyi tabiatda
  amazed AT = ...dan hayratda
  appear ON the screen = ekranda
  IN my opinion = fikrimcha
  ready FOR = ...ga tayyor


⚠ 'TO BE HELD':

  = o'tkazilmoq (tadbir).


⚠ 'DESTRUCTION':

  = vayron qilish.

items.sentence: 1 The festival is held ___ the beginning of August every year.
items.uz: Festival har yili avgust boshida o'tkaziladi.

items.sentence: 2 He put on a hat to protect himself ___ the sun.
items.uz: U o'zini quyoshdan himoya qilish uchun shlyapa kiydi.

items.sentence: 3 Scientists are worried ___ the destruction of the rainforest.
items.uz: Olimlar tropik o'rmonning vayron qilinishi haqida tashvishda.

items.sentence: 4 The memories of the Rio carnival will stay ___ me forever.
items.uz: Rio karnavali xotiralari men bilan abadiy qoladi.

items.sentence: 5 Computers are ___ doubt a very useful invention.
items.uz: Kompyuterlar, shubhasiz, juda foydali ixtiro.

items.sentence: 6 Elephants should live and breed ___ the wild.
items.uz: Fillar yovvoyi tabiatda yashashi va ko'payishi kerak.

items.sentence: 7 Josh was amazed ___ the beauty of the place.
items.uz: Josh joyning go'zalligidan hayratda qoldi.

items.sentence: 8 Bob's message appeared ___ the screen.
items.uz: Bobning xabari ekranda paydo bo'ldi.

items.sentence: 9 ___ my opinion, we should all help protect our planet.
items.uz: Mening fikrimcha, hammamiz sayyoramizni himoya qilishga yordam berishimiz kerak.

items.sentence: 10 Are you ready ___ the first question?
items.uz: Birinchi savolga tayyormisiz?

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in reported speech. (16 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ko'chirma gapda qayta yozing. (16 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 The WWF representative said
    (that) seals ARE in danger of
    extinction. (umumiy haqiqat -
    o'zgarmaydi; 'were' ham mumkin)
  2 Tom said (that) he HAD BEEN
    delighted to see such a rare
    animal. (was → had been)
  3 She said (that) we/they COULD
    help them with their campaign.
    (can → could)
  4 Jo asked me TO HELP her find
    something on the Internet.
    (iltimos → asked me to)
  5 The children said (that) they
    HAD GONE on a trip to the zoo.
    (went → had gone)
  6 Mr Brown said (that) he HAD
    NEVER BEEN TAUGHT how to use a
    computer. (have been taught →
    had been taught)
  7 Jane said (that) she HAD READ
    lots of magazine articles about
    shopping on the Internet.
    (I've read → she had read)
  8 He said (that) it IS a bad idea
    to give personal information to
    'chat friends'. (umumiy
    haqiqat; 'was' ham mumkin)


⚠ 4 - 'Can you ..., please?' =
iltimos → ko'chirma BUYRUQ: 'asked
me TO help'.


⚠ 'A REPRESENTATIVE':

  = vakil.


⚠ 'RARE':

  = noyob.

items.textEn: 1 "Seals are in danger of extinction," said the WWF representative. → The WWF representative said (that) ___.
items.answer: seals are in danger of extinction

items.textEn: 2 "I was delighted to see such a rare animal," said Tom. → Tom said (that) ___.
items.answer: he had been delighted to see such a rare animal

items.textEn: 3 "You can help us with our campaign," she said. → She said (that) ___.
items.answer: we could help them with their campaign
items.hintUz: can → could; you → we; us → them
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'we COULD help THEM with THEIR campaign'.

items.textEn: 4 "Can you help me find something on the Internet, please?" Jo asked me. → Jo asked me ___.
items.answer: to help her find something on the Internet
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'chirma iltimos: 'asked me TO HELP HER'.

items.textEn: 5 "We went on a trip to the zoo," said the children. → The children said (that) ___.
items.answer: they had gone on a trip to the zoo

items.textEn: 6 "I have never been taught how to use a computer," said Mr Brown. → Mr Brown said (that) ___.
items.answer: he had never been taught how to use a computer

items.textEn: 7 "I've read lots of magazine articles about shopping on the Internet," said Jane. → Jane said (that) ___.
items.answer: she had read lots of magazine articles about shopping on the Internet

items.textEn: 8 "It is a bad idea to give personal information to 'chat friends'," he said. → He said (that) ___.
items.answer: it is a bad idea to give personal information to 'chat friends'
items.whyUz: ⚠ Umumiy haqiqat → 'is' qoladi ('was' ham qabul qilinadi).

patterns.exampleEn: Tom said that he had been delighted to see the animal.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom hayvonni ko'rganidan juda xursand bo'lganini aytdi.

patterns.exampleEn: Jo asked me to help her find something on the Internet.
patterns.exampleUz: Jo mendan Internetda biror narsa topishga yordam berishni so'radi.

patterns.exampleEn: He said that seals are in danger of extinction.
patterns.exampleUz: U tyulenlar yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida ekanini aytdi.
